node.statement: Case m > 1: apply lem-maincb-direct-sum-inclusion-merge with B_1=C^{m-1}, B_2=C^2, P_1=P_old, P_2=P_fresh, v_1=v_old, and v_2=v_fresh. All of its hypotheses are exactly among the raw-call hypotheses and t <= e_1=e_dir. It yields the sum map as an extended C_dir*t-inclusion on C^{m-1} direct-sum C^2 = C^{m+1}; since C_dir*t <= D_1*t, defect-parameter monotonicity gives the required extended D_1*t-inclusion into A.
